name: Synchronize AD assets with Sekoia.io
description: Run one fetch cycle of the Microsoft Active Directory user asset connector as an action. Reads users from Active Directory and pushes them as assets to the matching asset connector configuration in Sekoia.io. Designed to run on an on-premise runner so Active Directory is never exposed to Sekoia.io.

asset_connector_uuid.title: Asset connector UUID
asset_connector_uuid.description: UUID of the asset connector configuration to push the assets to, and that owns the checkpoint and the logs

connector_configuration_token.title: Connector configuration token
connector_configuration_token.description: Token used to send the connector logs to Sekoia.io

basedn.title: Base DN
basedn.description: The base distinguished name (DN) to use for LDAP queries (e.g DC=example-domain,DC=com)

sekoia_base_url.title: Sekoia.io base URL
sekoia_base_url.description: Base URL of the Sekoia.io API of your region

sekoia_api_key.title: Sekoia.io API key
sekoia_api_key.description: API key allowed to push assets to the asset connector

batch_size.title: Chunk Size
batch_size.description: Number of assets to send in each batch to Sekoia.io

fetched.description: Number of assets fetched from Active Directory during the cycle

pushed_batches.description: Number of asset batches successfully pushed to Sekoia.io

failed_batches.description: Number of asset batches that could not be pushed to Sekoia.io. The cycle stops at the first failure, the run ends in error and the next scheduled run restarts from the previous checkpoint

has_more.description: Whether the cycle was interrupted before its end and the action should run again to resume
